Complementary, analogous and triadic harmony swatches; click one to convert it
tools.tip: HSL is often the easiest format for tweaking hue or lightness during UI exploration, then you can convert back to HEX for production tokens.

tools.name: HTTP Status Lookup

One-click copy for code and label pairs
tools.tip: If you keep seeing 304 responses in DevTools, that often means browser caching is working exactly as intended rather than your request failing.

tools.name: MIME Type Lookup

Exact match panel for fast lookups during debugging

tools.name: User Agent Parser

Includes desktop and mobile sample strings for quick testing
Keeps parsing entirely client-side in the browser
tools.tip: User-Agent parsing is heuristic by nature, so treat the result as a practical hint rather than a security-grade identifier.

tools.name: ASCII Table

Searches by character, label, or encoded value
Highlights control characters and printable characters in one table

tools.name: Hash Comparator

Shows normalized versions side by side for quick inspection

tools.tip: If your hashes differ only in uppercase vs lowercase hex digits, this tool will still mark them as equal.

tools.name: HTTP Header Parser
tools.description: Parse raw HTTP request or response headers into structured rows and JSON.

Generates a copyable JSON representation
Runs fully client-side with no network requests

tools.name: Basic Auth Header

features: Builds a ready-to-paste Authorization header from credentials
Decodes an existing Basic header into username and password fields
Keeps all encoding and decoding local in the browser
tools.tip: Basic auth is transport-safe only when paired with HTTPS because the credentials are merely encoded, not encrypted.

tools.name: Unix Permissions Calculator
tools.description: Convert read, write, and execute bits into chmod octal and symbolic permission strings.
features: Interactive owner, group, and others checkboxes
Live octal and symbolic output
Copy actions for both common permission formats
tools.tip: A common executable file mode is 755, which maps to rwxr-xr-x.

tools.name: Local AI Text Assistant
tools.description: Summarize text, surface keywords, detect action items, and estimate sentiment fully in JavaScript with no API.

Generates summary bullets, top keywords, action items, and a sentiment hint
Useful for quick internal notes, drafts, bug reports, and review workflows

tools.name: CSV to Markdown

Handles CSV and TSV formats

features: Text to Hex
Hex to Text
Client-side processing

Decode Base32 back to UTF-8 text
Optional "=" padding when encoding
Decoding accepts lower case, spaces and missing padding
Clear errors for invalid characters, misplaced padding and impossible lengths
Swap the output back into the input to convert the other way

tools.name: MAC Address Generator

features: Configurable delimiter styles: standard colon (00:1A:2B), hyphen (00-1A-2B), and Cisco dot (001a.2b3c.4d5e)
Custom uppercase or lowercase hexadecimal casing
Bulk generation with one-click copy and list download
100% in-browser generation with zero network requests
tools.tip: Use Cisco dot notation (xxxx.xxxx.xxxx) when provisioning Cisco IOS and network switch configurations.

tools.name: RSA Key Generator

Option to trim trailing whitespace or separators
tools.tip: Toggle the "Prefix / Numbering" option to prefix each repetition, making it easy to create numbered list structures or track iterations.

tools.name: AI Token Counter & Visualizer
